# Quotes sub-actions

## Add quote

Saves a new quote, with who said it and the game at the time. Good for a !addquote command that saves what a viewer typed.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Quote text** | The quote itself. The default %input% is what a viewer typed after the command. Starts as: `%input%`. |
| **User** | Who said it. The default %user% is whoever started the action. Use %input0% to quote someone else. Starts as: `%user%`. |
| **User id** | The speaker's id on their site. Usually leave the default. Starts as: `%userId%`. |
| **Platform** | The site the speaker is on, like twitch. The default %platform% is whoever started the action. Starts as: `%platform%`. |
| **Game / category** | The game or category to save with the quote. Empty = whatever your streaming site last reported. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if the quote was saved |
| `%quoteId%` | The new quote's number |
| `%quote%` | The quote's text |
| `%quoteUser%` | Who said it |
| `%quoteGame%` | The game or category |
| `%quoteCount%` | How many quotes there are now |

<small>Type id: `quotes.add`</small>

## Delete quote

Deletes a saved quote by its number. Good for a mod-only !delquote command.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Quote id** | The quote's number, like 12 or #12. The default %input0% is the first word a viewer typed after the command. Starts as: `%input0%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if the quote existed and was deleted |
| `%quote%` | The deleted quote's text |
| `%quoteCount%` | How many quotes are left |

<small>Type id: `quotes.delete`</small>

## Edit quote

Changes a saved quote: its text, who said it, or its game. Anything you leave empty stays as it was.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Quote id** | The quote's number, like 12 or #12. The default %input0% is the first word a viewer typed after the command. Starts as: `%input0%`. |
| **New text** | The new text. Empty keeps the old text. |
| **New user** | The new speaker. Empty keeps the old one. |
| **New game / category** | The new game or category. Empty keeps the old one. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%quoteUpdated%` | True if the quote was found and changed |
| `%quote%` | The quote's text now |
| `%quoteUser%` | Who said it |

<small>Type id: `quotes.edit`</small>

## Get quote

Looks up a saved quote and puts it in variables so you can say it in chat. Give a number for a certain quote, or leave it empty for a random one.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Quote id** | The quote's number, like 12 or #12. Empty, or not a number, picks a random quote. The default %input0% is the first word after the command. Starts as: `%input0%`. |
| **Random among quotes containing** | Only for random: pick only from quotes that contain this text, user or game, like "minecraft". Empty = any quote. |
| **Fire 'Quote shown' trigger** | Tick to also start actions with the "Quote shown" trigger. Untick to read the quote quietly. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%quoteFound%` | True if a quote was found |
| `%quoteId%` | The quote's number |
| `%quote%` | The quote's text |
| `%quoteUser%` | Who said it |
| `%quoteGame%` | The game or category at the time |
| `%quoteDate%` | The date it was saved |
| `%quoteCount%` | How many quotes there are |

<small>Type id: `quotes.get`</small>

## Get quote count

Counts your saved quotes and puts the number in a variable.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%quoteCount%` | How many quotes there are |

<small>Type id: `quotes.count`</small>
